chunks: Abu Ja'far and Abu 'Abdillah, peace be upon them, were asked, and it was said to them: We buy clothes that wine and the fat of a pig come into contact with during their weaving; may we pray in them before we wash them?
They both said: Yes, there is no harm. Allah has only forbidden eating it and drinking it, and He has not forbidden wearing it, touching it, or praying in it.

key_terms.الْخَمْرُ: wine or intoxicating liquid mentioned as contacting the garment
key_terms.الْخِنْزِيرِ: pig, whose fat is mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.ثِيَابًا: garments or clothes being discussed for use in salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: Can one perform salat (prayer) in clothes that were touched by wine or pig fat before washing them?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning garments that come into contact with wine or pig fat during tailoring or weaving. The Imams عليهما السلام state that the prohibition relates to eating and drinking, and that wearing such garments, touching them, and performing salat (prayer) in them is not prohibited.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.751 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) and Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) were asked:
"We buy clothes that may have come into contact with wine or the fat of a pig during their tailoring. Should we pray in them before washing them?"
They replied: "Yes, there is no harm. Allah (swt) has only forbidden eating and drinking it (pork and wine) but has not forbidden wearing it, touching it, or praying in it."
